newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down ahead of weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down ahead of weekend.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended down on Friday amid dull trading as investors and institutions stayed out before the Saturday-Sunday weekend, and dealers said the index would remain range-bounded in the near term.

"The country's weak economic fundamentals continue to dissuade investors from coming to this market," dealer Ali Asghar said. "Trading volume has declined and only speculators are generating activity. The index is likely to remain range-bounded in the near term. "
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) index fell 8.09 points, or 0.52 percent, to end at 1,548.05. Losers led gainers 181 to 45.
Turnover fell to 28.29 million shares from 48.75 million on Thursday.
Hub Power fell 0.45 to 36.45 rupees, ICI Pakistan 0.15 to 23.75 and PTCL 0.15 to 28.60.
